ui.title: Order-to-Cash Revenue Leakage Monitor (SAP)
ui.tagline: Finds revenue that leaks between order and cash in SAP S/4HANA: matches every delivery to its order and invoice in code (not by guesswork), flags unbilled deliveries, under-billing and unexplained credits, explains the root causes, and once finance agrees raises debit memo requests on billing block for the billing team to release.

suggestions: Period 2026-09. These documents were read: orders [{order: SO1, line: 10, customer: C1, unit_price: 100}], deliveries [{order: SO1, line: 10, qty: 5}], invoices [], credit notes [{number: CN9, customer: C2, amount: 300, reason_code: null}]. Reply as instructed.
